How does soap clean grease?

Soap helps remove grease and dirt because it lets oil and water mix together!
copy.tl:
Paano naglilinis ang sabon ng mantika?

Tinatanggal ng sabon ang mantika at dumi dahil pinaghahalo nito ang langis at tubig!
copy.bis:
Giunsa paglimpyo sa sabon sa tambok?

Gikuha sa sabon ang tambok ug hugaw kay gisagol niini ang lana ug tubig!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Regular soap reacts with them to form an insoluble soap scum

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Regular soap reacts with them to form an insoluble soap scum
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that the formation of new bonds or the breaking of existing bonds constitutes a chemical change and the formation of a new substance
assignedReviews.reason: The card states that soap reacts to form a new substance (scum), but it does not explain that bond breaking/formation constitutes a chemical change or that a new substance is formed. It only gives an example without the conceptual explanation required.

copy.en:
Why does soap leave a sticky scum in hard water?

Hard water has lots of calcium and magnesium minerals. Regular soap reacts with them to form an insoluble soap scum, but synthetic detergents clean effectively without leaving any scum behind!
copy.tl:
Bakit nag-iiwan ng scum ang sabon sa hard water?

Ang hard water ay maraming calcium at magnesium minerals. Ang regular soap ay gumagawa ng insoluble soap scum, pero ang synthetic detergents ay naglilinis nang epektibo nang hindi nag-iiwan ng scum!
copy.bis:
Nganong nagbilin og scum ang sabon sa hard water?

Ang hard water daghan og calcium ug magnesium minerals. Ang regular soap nagbuo og insoluble soap scum, pero ang synthetic detergents naglimpyo nga epektibo nga walay gibilin nga scum!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It doesn't lather well!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the indicators for a chemical reaction as color change, the formation of a precipitate, the release of gas, and or odor, or a change in temperature
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a practical effect of hard water on soap but does not mention any indicator of a chemical reaction (color change, precipitate, gas, odor, or temperature change). It is only tangentially related to chemical reactions.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It doesn't lather well!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses soap in hard water but does not describe uniform or non-uniform mixtures, solutions, or suspensions. It is not a useful everyday example of mixture types.

copy.en:
What happens to soap in hard water?

It doesn't lather well! Because of the hard water, it only makes a little foam.
copy.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa sabon sa matigas na tubig?

Hindi ito nabubulain nang maayos! Dahil sa matigas na tubig, kakaunti lang ang nabubuong bula.
copy.bis:
Unsay mahitabo sa sabon sa gahi nga tubig?

Dili kini maayo nga mabula! Tungod sa gahi nga tubig, gamay ra ang mahimong bula.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Its oil-loving end wraps around grease and dirt, while its water-loving end faces the water.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains how soap removes dirt using its amphiphilic structure. It does not describe uniform or non-uniform mixtures, solutions, or suspensions, so it does not directly support the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: while its water-loving end faces the water
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions water but does not identify a solute and solvent in a solution or explain their roles. The content is about soap's cleaning mechanism, not solution composition.

copy.en:
How does soap actually clean dirt?

Its oil-loving end wraps around grease and dirt, while its water-loving end faces the water. When you rinse, the dirt washes away with the soap!
copy.tl:
Paano ba talaga naglilinis ang sabon?

Binabalot ng oil-loving na dulo nito ang dumi, habang nakaharap sa tubig ang water-loving na dulo. Kapag binanlawan mo, naaanod palayo ang dumi kasama ng sabon!
copy.bis:
Unsaon man gyud paglimpyo ang sabon?

Giputos sa oil-loving nga tumoy niini ang hugaw, samtang nag-atubang sa tubig ang water-loving nga tumoy. Kung hugasan nimo, madala palayo ang hugaw uban sa sabon!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: This cool chemical reaction is called saponification!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that the formation of new bonds or the breaking of existing bonds constitutes a chemical change and the formation of a new substance
assignedReviews.reason: The card identifies saponification as a chemical reaction but does not explain bond formation/breaking or that a new substance is formed, which is the core of the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: This cool chemical reaction is called saponification!

assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions a chemical reaction but gives no indicator (color change, precipitate, gas, odor, temperature change). It does not support describing indicators of a chemical reaction.

copy.en: Soap is made by mixing fat or oil with a strong base called lye. This cool chemical reaction is called saponification!
copy.tl: Ang sabon ay ginagawa sa paghahalo ng taba o langis sa malakas na base na lihiya. Ang prosesong kemikal na ito ay tinatawag na saponification!
copy.bis: Ang sabon gihimo pinaagi sa pagsagol sa tambok o lana ug kusog nga base nga lihiya. Ang kemikal nga proseso niini gitawag og saponification!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Many soap molecules surround the oil drop to form a tiny ball all around it!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions

copy.en:
What do soap molecules do to a drop of oil?

Many soap molecules surround the oil drop to form a tiny ball all around it!
copy.tl:
Ano ang ginagawa ng maraming molekula ng sabon sa isang patak ng langis?

Pinapalibutan ito ng maraming molekula ng sabon para gumawa ng maliit na bola sa paligid nito!
copy.bis:
Unsay buhaton sa daghang molekula sa sabon sa usa ka patak sa lana?

Daghang molekula sa sabon ang molibot sa patak sa lana aron maghimo og gamay nga bola palibot niini!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Soft things like pillows and cloth absorb sound waves
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and describe how sound is made and transferred in everyday situations, such as the ringing of a bell or the hearing of noises
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes sound absorption, not how sound is made or transferred. It shares the topic of sound but does not directly support the competency's focus on sound production and transmission in everyday situations.

copy.en: Soft things like pillows and cloth absorb sound waves, which makes the sound much quieter for us!
copy.tl: Ang malalambot na bagay tulad ng unan at tela ay sumisipsip ng tunog, kaya nagiging mas mahina ito!
copy.bis: Ang humok nga mga butang sama sa unlan ug panapton mosuyop sa tingog, mao nga mahimo kining mas hinay!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It has very few dissolved minerals
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card only mentions dissolved minerals in soft water; it does not describe uniform/non-uniform mixtures, solutions, suspensions, or everyday examples of mixtures.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It has very few dissolved minerals
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution
assignedReviews.reason: The card implies minerals are dissolved in water but never identifies the solute or solvent or their roles in a solution.

copy.en: Soft water is the opposite! It has very few dissolved minerals, just like clean rainwater.
copy.tl: Ang malambot na tubig ay may kakaunting natunaw na mineral lang, katulad ng malinis na tubig-ulan.
copy.bis: Ang humok nga tubig gamay ra kaayo og natunaw nga mineral, sama sa limpyo nga tubig-ulan.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in a guided investigation to identify the effect of different types of soil on the growth of plants
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses humus/compost improving soil and plant growth, but the competency requires a guided investigation identifying the effect of different types of soil (e.g., sandy, clay, silt, loam) on plant growth. assignedReviews.card_evidence: Humus is the dark part of soil made from decayed leaves, twigs, and organic matter!

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes humus as decayed organic matter in soil, which is related to soil formation, but the competency specifically requires explaining how soil is formed from rocks and minerals. copy.en: Humus is the dark part of soil made from decayed leaves, twigs, and organic matter! Adding compost (home-made humus) to soil improves it and helps plants grow bigger!
copy.tl: Ang humus ay ang madilim na bahagi ng lupa mula sa mga nabulok na dahon, sanga, at organic matter! Ang pagdadagdag ng compost (gawang humus sa bahay) sa lupa ay nagpapaganda nito at tumutulong lumaki ang mga halaman!
copy.bis: Ang humus mao ang ngitngit nga bahin sa yuta gikan sa nadunot nga mga dahon, sanga, ug organic matter! Ang pagdugang og compost (humus nga gihimo sa balay) sa yuta nagpahimo niini ug nagtabang sa mga tanaman nga motubo og mas dako!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Soil forms very slowly!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how soil is formed from rocks and minerals
assignedReviews.reason: The card only states that soil formation is a slow process taking hundreds of years, but does not explain how soil is formed from rocks and minerals. It does not teach the mechanism or process required by the competency.

copy.en:
Did you know soil takes forever to form?

Soil forms very slowly! It can take hundreds of years to build just one single centimeter of fertile soil.
copy.tl:
Alam mo ba na napakatagal mabuo ang lupa?

Napakabagal mabuo ng lupa! Maaaring umabot ng daan-daang taon para makabuo lamang ng iisang sentimetro ng matabang lupa.
copy.bis:
Nahibaw-an ba nimo nga hinay kaayo maporma ang yuta?

Hinay kaayo nga maporma ang yuta! Mahimong moabot og ginatos ka tuig aron makahimo lamang og usa ka sentimetro nga tambok nga yuta.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Shiny mirrors gather sunlight onto one spot

copy.en: You can cook with just the sun! Shiny mirrors gather sunlight onto one spot, making it super hot — no electricity or fuel needed!
copy.tl: Puwedeng magluto gamit lang ang araw! Ang mga makintab na salamin ay nagtitipon ng sikat sa isang spot, kaya napakainit — walang kuryente o panggatong!
copy.bis: Mahimong magluto gamit ra ang adlaw! Ang sinaw nga salamin motipok sa kahayag sa adlaw sa usa ka dapit, busa mainit kaayo — walay koryente o sugnod!

copy.tl: Ang malaking solar farm ay gumagamit ng libu-libong panel para makagawa ng kuryente para sa maraming bahay!
copy.bis: Ang daghang solar farm naggamit ug liboan ka panel aron makahimo ug kuryente alang sa daghang balay!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A solar panel turning sunlight into electricity is a modern check that the Sun's energy is real and useful!

copy.en:
How do we know the Sun's energy is real and not just a story?

A solar panel turning sunlight into electricity is a modern check that the Sun's energy is real and useful!
copy.tl:
Paano natin malalaman na totoo ang enerhiya ng Araw at hindi lang kwento?

Ang solar panel na nagiging kuryente mula sa sikat ng Araw ay patunay na totoo at kapaki-pakinabang ang enerhiya nito!
copy.bis:
Unsaon nato pagsiguro nga tinuod ang enerhiya sa Sun ug dili lang istorya?

Ang solar panel nga nag-convert sa kahayag sa Sun ngadto sa kuryente nagpamatuod nga tinuod ug mapuslanon ang enerhiya sa Sun!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: About 4.6 billion years ago, a giant cloud of gas and dust collapsed! The center became the Sun, and the rest formed a protoplanetary disk where planets grew.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: distinguish among comets, meteoroids, asteroids, and dwarf planets, and describe how they help us to understand the nature and formation of the Earth and the Solar System

copy.en:
How did our solar system form?

About 4.6 billion years ago, a giant cloud of gas and dust collapsed! The center became the Sun, and the rest formed a protoplanetary disk where planets grew.
copy.tl:
Paano nabuo ang ating solar system?

Mga 4.6 bilyong taon na ang nakalipas, isang malaking ulap ng gas at alikabok ang nag-collapse! Ang sentro ay naging Araw, at ang natira ay naging protoplanetary disk kung saan lumaki ang mga planeta.
copy.bis:
Unsaon pagporma sa atong solar system?

Mga 4.6 bilyon ka tuig na ang milabay, usa ka dako nga panganod sa gas ug abug ang nag-collapse! Ang sentro nahimong Adlaw, ug ang nahibilin nahimong protoplanetary disk diin nagtubo ang mga planeta.

What do mixed nuts, gravel and sand, and a steel bar have in common?

They are all solid-solid mixtures, where two or more solid materials are combined but each keeps its own shape and properties.
copy.tl:
Ano ang pagkakapareho ng mixed nuts, gravel at buhangin, at steel bar?

Lahat sila ay solid-solid mixtures, kung saan pinagsama ang dalawa o higit pang solid materials pero nananatili ang sariling hugis at katangian ng bawat isa.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang parehas sa mixed nuts, gravel ug balas, ug steel bar?

Kini silang tanan mga solid-solid mixtures, diin ang duha o daghan pang solid materials gisagol apan ang matag usa nagpabilin sa kaugalingong porma ug mga kinaiya.

copy.en: Most organic compounds dissolve in nonpolar solvents like oil, but not in polar solvents like water.
copy.tl: Karamihan sa organic compounds ay natutunaw sa nonpolar solvents tulad ng langis, ngunit hindi sa polar solvents tulad ng tubig.
copy.bis: Kadaghanan sa organic compounds matunaw sa nonpolar solvents sama sa lana, apan dili sa polar solvents sama sa tubig.

It does not state that all matter is particulate or that each pure substance has its own kind of particles. The content is a specific dissolution example, not a direct description of the particle model.

copy.en:
When sugar dissolves in water, does it just disappear?

Nope, it doesn't disappear! It is still there, making the water taste sweet. The sugar just breaks into pieces too tiny to see.
copy.tl:
Kapag natunaw ang asukal sa tubig, nawawala ba ito?

Hindi, hindi ito nawawala! Nandiyan pa rin ito, kaya naman matamis ang tubig. Ang asukal ay nahati lang sa napakaliit na piraso na hindi nakikita.
copy.bis:
Kon matunaw ang asukal sa tubig, mawala ba kini?

Dili, dili kini mawala! Naa pa gihapon kini, mao nga tam-is ang tubig. Ang asukal nabahin lang sa gagmay kaayong piraso nga dili na makita.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Some egg-laying animals stand guard over their eggs
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify which groups of animals reproduce by giving birth to live young, such as mammals, and which reproduce by laying eggs, such as birds and reptiles
assignedReviews.reason: The card only mentions that some egg-laying animals guard eggs. It does not identify which groups of animals give birth to live young versus lay eggs, nor does it name groups such as mammals, birds, or reptiles.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the characteristics of living things: they grow, respond, and reproduce
assignedReviews.reason: The card touches on reproduction indirectly by referring to egg-laying animals, but it does not describe the characteristic of reproducing, growing, or responding. It focuses on parental guarding behavior, not on the defining characteristics of living things.

copy.en: Some egg-laying animals stand guard over their eggs so predators can't get to them.
copy.tl: May mga hayop na nangingitlog na nagbabantay sa kanilang itlog para hindi ito makain ng kaaway.
copy.bis: Ang ubang mga hayop nga nangitlog nagbantay sa ilang itlog aron dili kini makan-on sa kaaway.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A sore throat happens when your throat swells up while your body is busy fighting off germs.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions throat swelling but does not describe how any human body system (muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, or respiratory) works. It provides no information about organ functions or system processes, so it does not directly support the competency.

copy.en: A sore throat happens when your throat swells up while your body is busy fighting off germs.
copy.tl: Ang masakit na lalamunan ay nangyayari kapag namamaga ito habang nilalabanan ng katawan ang mga germs.
copy.bis: Ang sakit nga tutunlan mahitabo kung mohubag kini samtang gilabanan sa lawas ang mga mikrobyo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: What was the first aircraft to fly faster than the speed of sound?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that how far an object moves in a given time is called speed
assignedReviews.reason: The card is a trivia fact about the Bell X-1 being the first supersonic aircraft. It mentions 'speed of sound' but does not teach or support the concept that speed is how far an object moves in a given time. No distance/time relationship is presented.

copy.en:
What was the first aircraft to fly faster than the speed of sound?

The Bell X-1 was the first aircraft to fly faster than the speed of sound!
copy.tl:
Ano ang unang eroplanong lumipad nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog?

Ang Bell X-1 ang unang eroplanong lumipad nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog!
copy.bis:
Unsa ang unang ayroplano nga milupad nga mas tulin pa sa tingog?

Ang Bell X-1 mao ang unang ayroplano nga milupad nga mas tulin pa sa tingog!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Soft things like pillows and curtains soak up sound instead of bouncing it!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and describe how sound is made and transferred in everyday situations, such as the ringing of a bell or the hearing of noises
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes sound absorption by soft materials, not how sound is made or transferred. It does not support the competency's focus on sound production and transmission in everyday situations.

copy.en: Soft things like pillows and curtains soak up sound instead of bouncing it! Shouting into a pillow makes a muffled sound, which is why recording studios use soft walls to trap sound.
copy.tl: Ang malalambot na bagay tulad ng unan at kurtina ay humihigop ng tunog! Kaya mahina ang sigaw sa unan, at gumagamit ng malalambot na pader ang recording studio para makulong ang tunog.
copy.bis: Ang humok nga butang sama sa unlan ug kurtina mosuyop sa tingog! Mao nga hinay ang singgit sa unlan, ug nagagamit og humok nga bongbong ang recording studio aron mapugngan ang tingog.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the factors affecting the rates of chemical reactions as applied in food preservation and materials production, control of fire, pollution, and corrosion
assignedReviews.reason: The card addresses conservation of atoms in a chemical reaction, not the factors affecting reaction rates (temperature, concentration, surface area, catalysts) nor applications to food preservation, fire, pollution, or corrosion. copy.tl: Ang mga atom na bumubuo sa products ng isang chemical reaction ay nagmumula lamang sa reactants, dahil walang bagong atom na nalilikha o nasisira.
copy.bis: Ang mga atomo nga naglangkob sa products sa usa ka chemical reaction naggikan lamang sa reactants, tungod kay walay bag-ong atomo nga mamugna o malaglag.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: They want to send humans to Mars in the 2030s!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the general structure of the solar system, identifying the names of the major celestial objects, their main features, and general composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses future human exploration of Mars and a Moon base, but does not describe the general structure of the solar system, the names of major celestial objects, their main features, or their composition. It only mentions Mars and the Moon without the required descriptive content.

copy.en:
Where do space agencies like NASA and SpaceX plan to send humans next?

They want to send humans to Mars in the 2030s! First, they plan to build a Moon base as a stopover before the longer journey to the Red Planet!
copy.tl:
Saan plano ng mga space agency tulad ng NASA at SpaceX na ipadala ang mga tao?

Gusto nilang ipadala ang mga tao sa Mars sa 2030s! Una, magtatayo sila ng Moon base bilang stopover bago ang mas mahabang paglalakbay sa Red Planet!
copy.bis:
Asa man nagplano ang mga space agency sama sa NASA ug SpaceX nga ipadala ang mga tawo?

Gusto nilang ipadala ang mga tawo sa Mars sa 2030s! Una, magtukod sila og Moon base isip stopover sa wala pa ang mas dugay nga biyahe sa Red Planet!

copy.bis: Sa kawanangan, walay hangin, mao nga itom ang langit kay walay mga molekula nga magkatag sa kahayag sa adlaw!

copy.tl: Baka matapon ang tasa? Ilagay ang ekstrang tasa sa listahan ng materyales! Para hindi maputol ang buong pagsubok kapag may aksidente.
copy.bis: Basin matulo ang tasa? Ibutang ang extra nga tasa sa lista sa materyales! Aron dili maputol ang tibuok pagsulay kung naay aksidente.

copy.en:
Do waves always travel at the same speed?

Nope! Mechanical waves change speed when they enter a different medium — like going from air to water to rock!
copy.tl:
Lagi bang pareho ang bilis ng mga alon?

Hindi! Nagbabago ang bilis ng mechanical waves kapag pumasok sa ibang medium — tulad ng hangin, tubig, o bato!
copy.bis:
Kanunay ba nga pareho ang kusog sa mga balod?

Dili! Ang mechanical waves mo-usab ug kusog kung mosulod sa lahi nga medium — sama sa hangin, tubig, o bato!

copy.en:
How fast does light actually travel?

The speed of light is about 299,792 kilometers per second, or nearly 300,000 km/s!
copy.tl:
Gaano kabilis talaga ang liwanag?

Ang bilis ng liwanag ay humigit-kumulang 299,792 kilometro kada segundo, o halos 300,000 km/s!
copy.bis:
Unsa ka paspas ang kahayag?

Ang tulin sa kahayag mga 299,792 ka kilometro kada segundo, o duol sa 300,000 km/s!

How is speed often written?

Speed is often written in kilometers per hour (km/h) or meters per second (m/s)!

Ang bilis ay madalas isulat sa kilometro kada oras (km/h) o metro kada segundo (m/s)!
copy.bis:
Unsaon pagsulat sa katulin?

Ang katulin sagad isulat sa kilometro kada oras (km/h) o metro kada segundo (m/s)!

copy.bis: Ang sperm mao ang male reproductive cells nga gihimo sa testes, ug gikinahanglan kini aron ma-fertilize ang egg cell sa babaye.

How do sperm whales talk to each other?

Besides finding food, sperm whales use patterns of clicks to 'talk' with their family!

Bukod sa paghahanap ng pagkain, gumagamit ang mga sperm whale ng mga click na may pattern para mag-usap sa kanilang pamilya!
copy.bis:
Unsaon pag-istoryahanay sa mga sperm whale?

Gawas sa pagpangita og pagkaon, mogamit ang mga sperm whale og mga click nga adunay pattern aron mag-istoryahanay sa ilang pamilya!

Just two — the cephalothorax, where the head and chest are joined together, and the abdomen.

Ilang bahagi ang katawan ng gagamba?

Dalawa lang — ang cephalothorax, na pinagsamang ulo at dibdib, at ang abdomen.
copy.bis:
Pila ka bahin ang lawas sa lawalawa?

Duha ra — ang cephalothorax, ang gihiusang ulo ug dughan, ug ang abdomen.

copy.bis: Samtang molakaw, magbilin ang lawalawa og hilo nga sama sa pisi nga makasalo kon kini mahulog.

Ang gagamba ay may walong paa.

Ang lawalawa adunay walo ka tiil.

It has two main parts: the head-chest (cephalothorax) and the abdomen.

May dalawang pangunahing bahagi ito: ang ulo-dibdib at ang tiyan.
copy.bis:

Adunay duha ka panguna nga bahin kini: ang ulo-dughan ug ang tiyan.

copy.bis: Daghang lawalawa maghimo na lang og bag-ong sapot kon maguba na ang ilang daan.

What carries messages from your brain?

The spinal cord! This thick bundle of nerves inside your backbone carries messages between your brain and the rest of your body.

Unsa ang nagdala sa mensahe sa utok?

Ang spinal cord! Baga nga hugpong kini sa nerbiyos sulod sa bukog sa likod nga nagdala sa mensahe gikan sa utok ngadto sa tibuok lawas.
